name: Wellness exam
description: A nose-to-tail check, weight and diet talk, and a plan for the year ahead.

name: Core vaccines
description: Rabies, DHPP or FVRCP, given on a schedule that fits your pet's life — not every vaccine every year.

name: Puppy or kitten series
description: Three visits over the first months: exams, vaccines, deworming, and all the questions.

name: Microchip
description: Implanted in seconds, registered before you leave.

name: Sick visit
description: Same-day exam for anything that's off — limping, itching, an upset stomach.

name: Blood panel
description: In-house results within the hour, so we can talk options at the same visit.

name: Digital X-rays
description: Two views with a same-day read, shown to you on screen.

name: Dental cleaning
description: Under anesthesia with full-mouth X-rays, scaling, and polishing. Extractions quoted first.

name: Spay or neuter
description: Pre-surgical bloodwork, pain relief, and a recovery call the next morning, all included.

name: Lump removal
description: Removal and lab analysis, with a clear estimate after the first exam.
